title: Split astrbot-web HTTP boundary
description: Separate WebChat HTTP DTOs, route wiring, server startup, message conversion, error mapping, and tests so dashboard/API breadth can grow without coupling to lib.rs.

files.change: Move submit/history response structs and serde helpers.
Move submit payload normalization and response serialization.

criteria: lib.rs exposes the public web API without owning all implementation details.
HTTP layer still only calls WebChatPlatform boundary.

implementation_steps: Move DTOs and serde helpers first.
Move MessageChain conversion functions with focused tests.

result.summary: astrbot-web lib.rs is now a facade; DTOs, error mapping, message-part conversion, route handlers, server helpers, and tests live in focused modules while public exports remain compatible.
